question: Can actively chosen causal-disambiguation probes increase actual delayed/reversing-world reward over the same exact probe count and online updater with random probes, and an independently adaptive recurrent baseline?
null: Active information probes do not consistently yield >=.05 reward-per-action advantage across delay2, delay3 and changing_delay over matched passive probes, same updater no probes, deliberately action-history-corrupted learning, and adapted GRU; action-effect sham remains unverifiable beyond its known synthetic settings.

design.probe_schedule: At scored times 0,4,...,60. Fixed before outcomes for active, random probe, scrambled history, adaptive GRU, frozen GRU. No probe arm has zero required probes.
design.lag_design: Full discounted regularized 5×5 P12 sufficient statistics; action-conditioned [a_t,a_t-1,a_t-2,a_t-3]. Only factual chosen-action outcomes update.
design.active_probe: Before each fixed probe, maximize x(a)^T G^-1 x(a) separately for +1 and -1 actions using current completed factual history. Never inspect future outcome or hidden world lag.
design.passive_random_probe: At exact same 16 probe slots, compute both D-opt scores but choose ±1 from registered seeded random draw. Identical updater, dimensionality, feedback and opportunities; comparable matrix operations.
design.exploitation: Nonprobe chooses sign of sum of learned current+future lag coefficients for expected 4-event action effect, or random if absolute effect under 0.08. Equal across online arms.
design.incorrect_timing_negative: At factual update, shuffle historic action order before forming lag features; breaks lag→result alignment, NOT merely permuting coefficient columns.
design.no_probe_negative: Same online optimizer + 64 factual updates but zero mandatory exploratory probes
design.baseline_adaptive_GRU: Clone exact original P11 trained GRU, same history/action/observed consequence each step, model-parameter AdamW lr .001 after each factual result, 64 online updates; same 16 forced random probes; measured wall time and no unobserved targets. FLOPs not equal to ridge.
design.baseline_frozen_GRU: Exact same pre-trained GRU and 16 probe opportunities but zero online model updates

original_HYPOTHESIS_thresholds.support: 3/3 original model initializations AND separate four DEV world seeds, recognizing repeated source world seeds across inits
